title: Instant Share of the Cleared Balance by Payout Record, Pocketwire Business Profile
content:
The instant share of the cleared balance of a Pocketwire Business Profile follows the profile's payout record:

1. when a payout return is dated within the rolling 3 months ending on the handling date, the cleared balance is halved and rounded down to whole dollars;
2. when there is none but fewer than 12 payouts are dated within the rolling 12 months ending on the handling date, the cleared balance is multiplied by 0.8 and rounded down to whole dollars;
3. otherwise the whole cleared balance is kept to the cent.

A cleared balance below zero counts as zero. Payouts of every kind — to a bank account, to a debit card or to the owner's personal balance — count toward the 12, and a return of any payout counts as a payout return. A rolling window of a number of months ending on the handling date covers the dates after the same calendar day that many months earlier, up to and including the handling date.

| Payout return in the rolling 3 months | Payouts in the rolling 12 months | Instant share |
|---|---|---|
| at least one | any number | half the cleared balance, rounded down to whole dollars |
| none | fewer than 12 | the cleared balance multiplied by 0.8, rounded down to whole dollars |
| none | 12 or more | the whole cleared balance, to the cent |

## Worked figures (hypothetical cleared balance of USD 2325.55)

| Payout record | Instant share |
|---|---|
| a return in the 3 months | 1162.775, rounded down to USD 1162.00 |
| no return, 7 payouts in the 12 months | 1860.44, rounded down to USD 1860.00 |
| no return, 15 payouts in the 12 months | USD 2325.55 |
| any record, cleared balance of minus USD 50.00 | USD 0.00 |
